mapper.sql: id, dept_id, username, password, nickname, email, phone, sex, avatar, status, token_version, login_ip, login_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, deleted, version

if.test: dataScope != null and dataScope.rules != null and dataScope.rules.size() > 0

mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT password FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (dept_id, username, password, nickname, email, phone, sex, avatar, status, token_version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, deleted, version) VALUES (#{deptId}, #{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{phone}, COALESCE(#{sex}, 0), #{avatar}, COALESCE(#{status}, 1), COALESCE(#{tokenVersion}, 0), #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark}, COALESCE(#{deleted}, 0), COALESCE(#{version}, 0))

INSERT INTO sys_user (dept_id, username, password, nickname, email, phone, sex, avatar, status, token_version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, deleted, version) VALUES
(#{u.deptId}, #{u.username}, #{u.password}, #{u.nickname}, #{u.email}, #{u.phone}, COALESCE(#{u.sex}, 0), #{u.avatar}, COALESCE(#{u.status}, 1), COALESCE(#{u.tokenVersion}, 0), #{u.createBy}, #{u.createTime}, #{u.updateBy}, #{u.updateTime}, #{u.remark}, COALESCE(#{u.deleted}, 0), COALESCE(#{u.version}, 0))
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET password = #{password}, token_version = token_version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE sys_user SET token_version = token_version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE sys_user SET avatar = #{avatar}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE sys_user SET deleted = 1, username = CONCAT(username, '_deleted_', id), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT role_id FROM sys_user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT post_id FROM sys_user_post WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT u.id, u.dept_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.email, u.phone, u.sex, u.avatar, u.status, u.login_ip, u.login_time, u.create_time, u.remark, u.version, d.name AS dept_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE u.deleted = 0
SELECT ur.user_id FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_user u ON ur.user_id = u.id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.role_id = #{roleId}
